conditions.displayName: Cloud Scheduler could not start transit-pipeline

documentation.content:
Cloud Scheduler failed to start the weekly workflow, so no run took place.

`gcloud scheduler jobs describe transit-pipeline-weekly --location asia-northeast3 --project seoul-transit-prod --format="value(status,lastAttemptTime)"`

A permission error usually means `transit-workflow-sa` lost `roles/workflows.invoker`.
